༄༅/ /rdzogs pa chen ngal gso skor gsum gyi dkar chag pad+ma stong ldan zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rdzogs pa chen ngal gso skor gsum gyi dkar chag pad+ma

stong ldan zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / rdzogs pa chen po ngal gso skor gsum gyi dkar chag pad+ma stong ldan zhes bya ba/ dpal kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan bkra shis yon tan mtsho chen ldan/ /byang chub yid bzhin klu dbang snyingapo'i gnas/ / zab cing rgya che chos kyis yongs gang ba/ /kun bzang chos rje bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa'i chos tshul dpag med las/ / snying po'i don kun yang nas yongs bsdus pas/ /ngal gso skor gsum rin chen chos kyi mdzod/ /de yi dkar chag nges pa 'dir gsal bya/ /ngal gso skor gsum shing rta skor gsum dang/ phreng ba skor gsum khrid yig skor gsum dang*/ /legs bshad rgya mtsho pad+ma dkar po dang/ /dkar chag nyid dang rnams grangs bco lnga gnas/ /de dag so so'i dgos ched bstan pa ni/ / legs bshad rgya mtshos chos spyi'i don rnams bstan/ /theg pa'i babs dang chos kyi byung tshul dang/ /ji ltar bshad tshul ma rig mun pa sel/ /bshad pa'i sgrom bu 'di kun mchog tu gces/ /sde tshan dang po sems nyid ngal gso la/ lus dang yan lag bye brag bstan pa ni/ /ngal gso lus te 'byed 'brel yan lag go /sems nyid ngal gso theg chen snying po'i gzhi/ /ngo bo rang bzhin gnas tshul rgyas par bstan/ /thog ma bar dang tha ma'i lam rim rnams/ /tshang la ma nor nges don snying po yin/ /le'u bcu gsum gzhung gi rang lus rdzogs/ /de yi bsdu don kun+da'i phreng ba yis/ /sde tshan 'byed 'brel shin tu gsal bar byas/ /mthong ba tsam gyis gnas rnams rtogs pas na/ / 'byed 'brel lde mig mchog tu bzang po yin/ /shing rta chen po sems nyid ngal gso'i gnas/ /rgya cher 'grel pas kun tu mtha' yas nyid/ /tshig don 'byams klas rlabs chen gnas ston pas/ /zab cing rgya che 'jug ngogs chen po yin/ /de yi bsdus don pad+ma dkar po yis/ /snga phyi'i gnas dang don gyi ngo bo rnams/

/so sor 'byed 'brel don kun gsal byed yin/ /'brel bshad gnas su 'di kun gces pas zung/ /ngal gso'i don khrid byang chub lam bzang gis/ /skal bzang rigs gsum thar pa'i lam la 'dren/ /dge ba gsum gyi gnad gsum snying po can/ /med thabs med pas dad brgya'i gtsug gis gzung/ /de dag kun gyis sems nyid ngal gso'i skor/ /lus dang yan lag bye brag rdzogs par bstan/ /sde tshan gnyis pa bsam gtan ngal gso la/ /lus dang yan lag bye brag bstan pa ni/ /ngal gso lus zhes gzhan rnams yan lag go /bsam gtan ngal gso ting 'dzin 'od gsal lam/ /ji ltar bsgom tshul yang zab gnad rnams bstan/ /rdo rje'i gnas gsum de yi gzhung tshad rdzogs/ /gsang chen gnas 'di shin tu zab pas na/ /skal bzang rnams kyis rtag tu gces spras mdzod/ de yi bsdus don pun+ḍa rī ka yis/ /so so'i tshig don shin tu gsal bar byed/ /tshig nyung don 'grel go zhing rtogs pa sla/ /de phyir de yi gnas la shin tu gces/ /shing rta rnam dag bsam gtan ngal gso'i gnas /rgya cher 'grel pas tshig don gsal bar byas/ /yang zab gnad dang lung gi gnas gsal bas/ /nges shes skye zhing gzhan las mchog tu 'phags/ /de dag don khrid snying po bcud bsdus kyis/ /yang zab bsgom pa 'od gsal snying po bstan/ /gnad las ting 'dzin mngon du byed pa'i phyir/ med thabs med do rtag tu gus pas gzung*/ /de dag kun gyis bsam gtan ngal gso'i skor/ /lus dngayan lag bye brag rdzogs par bstan/ /sde tshan gsum pa sgyu ma ngal gso la/ /lus dngayan lag bye brag bstan pa ni/ /ngal gso lus yin 'byed 'brel don khrid bcas/ /de yi yan lag phran bu 'phros te bstan/ /sgyu ma ngal gsos spyod pa rnams sbyong ste/ /gnyis 'dzin bden zhen 'ching ba gcod par bstan/ /le'u brgyad kyis de yi gzhung tshad rdzogs/ /thar lam bgrod la 'di nyid med thabs med/

/de yi bsdu sa don man+dār ba yis/ /rig pa'i gnas rnams rab tu gsal bar byed/ skyes bu'i bzhin la me long bstan pa bzhin/ /de nyid rtogs pa'i gnas su gces pas gzung*/ /shing rta bzang pos sgyu ma ngal gso'i gnas/ /ma lus rang bzhin rgya cher 'grel pas na/ /blo gros snang ba rab tu rgyas byed yin/ /de dag don khrid yid bzhin nor bu yin/ /blang dor gnyis med sgyu ma mngon sum lam/ /bden med rtogs pas 'khor ba'i 'phrul snang 'jig /yang dag sgyu ma 'od gsal don ston pas/ /zab mo'i gnas 'di gus pas gces spras mdzod/ /de dag kun gyis sgyu ma ngal gso'i skor/ /lus dang yan lag bye brag rdzogs par bstan/ / rgyal bas chos tshul rin chen snying po'i don/ /ma lus gcig bsdus ngal gso skor gsum gyi/ /lus dang yan lag dkar chag bstan pa yis/ /ma lus 'gro kun mngon par sangs rgyas shog /tshul 'di theg mchog snying po'i rnal 'byor pa/ /dri med 'od stong nyin mor byed pa des/ /gangs ri thod dkar mgul du legs par bkod/ /dad ldan skye bo'i tshogs rnams dga' bar mdzod/ /rdzogs pa chen po ngal gso skor gsum gyi dkar chag pad+ma stong ldan zhes bya ba/ mang du thos pa'i rnal 'byor pa dre med 'od zer gyis kun du bzang po'i khang bzangs su bkod pa rdzogs so// //dge'o*/ /dge'o*/ dge'o/ / ༈ oṃ swa sti/ rmad byung mkhyen rab spyan gyis chos kun gzigs/ /gsang chen rgyud don rgya mtsho'i mdzod 'chang ba'i/ /kun mkhyen gnyis pa klong chen rab 'byams kyi/ /bka' drin bstan 'gro'i bla ru gsal 'di rmad/ /gang gi mdo sngags chos tshul bye ba'i bcud/ /rgyu 'bras theg pa rgya mtsho'i zab gnad kun/ /'gal med lam rim gcig tu yongs dril te/ /rang sems 'od gsal sngags kyi de kho na/ /ji bzhin ston pa'i thabs tshul bla na med/ / sems nyid gnas lugs ngang du ngal gso'i gzhung*/

/gnyug ma rang gnas zab mo'i ting nge 'dzin/ /ji bzhin sgoms pa'i lam gnad nor med du/ / ston pa bsam gtan ngal gso'i legs bshad phul/ /chos kun bden zhen 'ching ba bcad pa'i thabs/ /sgyu ma'i dpe brgyad lta bur ston pa yi/ /snying po'i nor mchog sgyu ma ngal gso ste/ /gzhung bzang ngal gso skor gsum zhes grags pa/ /yan lag bcas kun mi zad spar gyi 'phrul/ /sku gsung thugs kyi snang bsnyan gzhi 'di nyid/ /gcig las du ma 'char bar byed pa'i dpyid/ /rig 'dzin gar gyi dbang phyug bzhad pa rtsal/ /thugs bskyed shin tu dkar pos nye bar bsgrubs/ /dge des yid can srid pa'i 'gro tshogs kyis/ /rang gnas chos sku'i gnas lugs mngon sum du/ /rtogs te gdod ma sku bzhi'i sar phyin nas/ /phyam gcig byang chub chen po brnyes gyur cig / ces chos rje bla ma'i bkas bskul ngor gus 'bangs thub bstan snyan grags sam rig 'dzin gzhan phan rdo rjes sbyar ba'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (22) ngal gso skor gsum gyi dkar chag pad+ma stong ldan/ - PAGE 364 - - PAGE 363 -- PAGE 360 -
